purpose: A recorded verdict for every extra_metric coverage gap the report-only signal-fidelity check finds: a metric family a real collector shipped that synthkit does not emit. Keyed on area + substrate + folded family name so it survives a corpus refresh.
family_key_rule: The key is the metric family, not a series name. CloudWatch five-stat suffixes (_average/_maximum/_minimum/_sample_count/_sum) and Prometheus classic-histogram component suffixes (_bucket/_count/_sum) are folded off before lookup, matching the fold in internal/inventory/synth.go. A refresh that adds or drops individual stat suffixes or histogram components therefore resolves to the same verdict.

verdict_values.should_emit: A real deployment of something synthkit already claims to model produces this family, so its absence is a hole in a claim the project makes.
verdict_values.out_of_scope: Reality produces it, but it belongs to a component synthkit does not claim to model. The rationale records why so the next audit does not re-litigate it.
verdict_values.unresolved: Cannot be decided from the corpus and available documentation. Carries a cantfind.md PENDING id instead of a guessed verdict.

verdicts.modelled_claim: synthkit models a CoreDNS Corefile that does not load the hosts plugin.
verdicts.rationale: Reality produces this from the CoreDNS hosts plugin, which the corpus shows loaded against /etc/coredns/NodeHosts - a k3s-specific Corefile. The corpus authority is k3s only; no EKS-substrate evidence covers CoreDNS. synthkit deliberately models a Corefile with no hosts block, a decision already recorded in internal/construct/coredns/coredns.go where coredns_hosts_reload_timestamp_seconds is pinned at 0 with the comment "hosts plugin not used". Do not re-litigate without EKS-substrate evidence that the modelled Corefile loads the plugin.

not_coverage_gaps.note: synthkit emits this family. The gcx read-back producer records raw Prometheus classic-histogram component series (_bucket/_count/_sum) as separate metric entries, while internal/inventory/synth.go and e2e/inventory/inventory.go both fold those components into the histogram family base. The finding is producer asymmetry, not missing emission. It disappears when the read-back producer folds component suffixes.
